description: Checks MCP / function-calling tool definitions for tool poisoning (hidden instructions, data-exfiltration requests, hijack attempts in names, descriptions and schemas) before your agent installs or calls them. Use scan_text for ordinary content and scan_url for web pages. Up to 100 tools per call. Free: 30 calls/day per IP shared by scan_text, scan_url and scan_tools, with full results (max 10/min; invalid input is not counted). After that the tool returns an error with the x402 pay URL ($0.003 USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum One or Solana per call at https://api.youraitools.co/injectscan/v1/scan) or prepaid credits. Returns the worst risk_score/verdict, flagged, tools_scanned, tools_flagged and tools[] {index, name, risk_score, verdict, categories, findings[] {field, rule, text}}. Read-only safety signal, not a guarantee.

tools.description: 1-100 tool definitions as objects {name, description, inputSchema} (as returned by an MCP server's tools/list; input_schema or parameters are also read). Every string field, including nested schema descriptions, is scanned.

name: scan_tools
title: Scan MCP tool definitions for tool poisoning
